title: Form EIA-923 Monthly Power Plant Operations Data Through May 2026
summary: EIA's July 23 release extends monthly plant-level generation, fuel consumption, receipts, stocks, and selected operating data through May 2026.
key_findings: The files provide plant-level monthly observations rather than generator planning status.
Generation, fuel-use, receipt, cost, quality, and stock fields can be combined only with careful attention to file structure and reporting coverage.
Monthly and annual products have different release timing and can be revised.
why_it_matters: Form 923 supplies observed plant-operation evidence that complements Form 860's generator inventory and helps prevent planned capacity from being mistaken for production.
ftfn_relevance: Creates a bridge between generator inventory, fuel supply, and actual output.
Provides a recurring official-data rail for power-system updates.
evidence_limits: Reported plant operations do not prove local service availability for a named industrial customer.
Monthly data are subject to coverage, revision, aggregation, and confidentiality limitations.
Plant output alone does not establish transmission headroom, interconnection availability, reliability, emissions compliance, or marginal cost.
